class.name: IfcLaborResourceType
class.brief_description: The resource type IfcLaborResourceType defines commonly shared information for occurrences of labor resources. The set of shared information may include: common productivities common cost rates common properties within shared property sets It is used to define a labor resource specification (i.e. the specific resource information that is common to all occurrences of that resource). Resource types
class.description: Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files.

members.member: Defines types of labor resources. A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
